spanish: No se vuelvan a los evocadores y a los adivinos; no busquen para contaminarse en ellos; yo Jehová su Dios.

findings.issue: «evocadores» turns definite plural noun H178 into human agents who evoke and adds the act of evoking; the lemma stays open between the spirit and the practitioner.
«adivinos» turns definite plural noun H3049 into human fortune-tellers and adds divination; the lemma stays open between a knowing specialist and a ghost.
Pronominal «se vuelvan» smooths a qal jussive of turn; the stem is not reflexive.

notes: Verbless «yo Jehová su Dios» matches the clause; ustedes «su» keeps the 2mp suffix.
